CatchingTutorialBoxFullText:
#MON hide in
the grass. Who

knows when they'll
pop out…
CatchingTutorialIntroText:
I've seen you a
couple times. How

many #MON have
you caught?

Would you like me
to show you how to catch #MON?
CatchingTutorialDebriefText:
That's how you do
it.

If you weaken them
first, #MON are easier to catch.
CatchingTutorialDeclinedText:
Oh. Fine, then.

Anyway, if you
want to catch

#MON, you have
to walk a lot.
CatchingTutorialRepeatText:
Huh? You want me
to show you how to catch #MON?
Route29YoungsterText:
Yo. How are your
#MON?

If they're weak
and not ready for

battle, keep out
of the grass.
Route29TeacherText:
See those ledges?
It's scary to jump off them.

But you can go to
NEW BARK without

walking through
the grass.
Route29FisherText:
I wanted to take a
break, so I saved

to record my
progress.
Route29CooltrainerMText_WaitingForDay:
I'm waiting for
#MON that

appear only in the
daytime.
Route29CooltrainerMText_WaitingForNight:
I'm waiting for
#MON that

appear only at
night.
Route29CooltrainerMText_WaitingForMornin:
I'm waiting for
#MON that

appear only in the
morning.
MeetTuscanyText:
TUSCANY: I do be-
lieve that this is

the first time
we've met?

Please allow me to
introduce myself.

I am TUSCANY of
Tuesday.
TuscanyGivesGiftText:
By way of intro-
duction, please

accept this gift,
a PINK BOW.
TuscanyGaveGiftText:
TUSCANY: Wouldn't
you agree that it is most adorable?

It strengthens
normal-type moves.

I am certain it
will be of use.
TuscanyTuesdayText:
TUSCANY: Have you
met MONICA, my older sister?

Or my younger
brother, WESLEY?

I am the second of
seven children.
TuscanyNotTuesdayText:
TUSCANY: Today is
not Tuesday. That is unfortunate…
